text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text:
Can you hear it, the tolling of the new<n>generation's
bell? Can you see it, the<n>glimpse of my evolution
into the<n>Centurial Overlord? I feel both with<n>my very
soul.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text:
Only I, the strongest, am worthy of<n>inheriting the
history that the Golden<n>Generation carved with their
cleats.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text:
Thus, my next objective is where<n>only the truly
strong fight—the spring<n>Tenno Sho!
